script:
Wang Nurse
I am Nurse Wang, a nurse at Health Hospital. Three months ago, my half-sister Dr. Jia transferred to Health Hospital where I work. Over the years, she has always known of my existence. Although she knew my mother interfered in her parents' marriage, causing their divorce, she never targeted me. We just maintained a polite relationship. On her first day at work, I gave her a rabbit pen as congratulations.
Not long after my sister arrived, I noticed that Ke Accountant from the hospital looked at my sister with somewhat inappropriate eyes. Could this person have feelings for my sister? Although this Ke Accountant is a bit boring, he's still relatively honest.
But what I didn't expect was that on January 24th, my sister came down from the operating table, just handed me the forceps for final suturing, and collapsed on the ground. No matter how we tried to resuscitate her, she couldn't come back. Deputy Director Pan personally conducted the cause-of-death identification, concluding it was heart failure due to overwork. But that night, Deputy Director Pan happily asked me to drink with him. Our romantic relationship has lasted two years, but actually, I'm just using him to make my drug dealing in the hospital smoother. Selling drugs is not only a no-cost business but also has abundant buyer resources. For example, Bai Patient, who couldn't get a heart transplant, needed pain-relief medication. After discharge, he became my customer. There are many such people.
Unexpectedly, Deputy Director Pan got drunk that night and, in his excitement, revealed Dr. Jia's real cause of death - she was actually poisoned. But when I asked more, he refused to say anything else. Later, Ke Accountant asked me for my sister's death report. I secretly showed him the fake report. The fewer people who know about this, the better.
On January 26th, when I passed Deputy Director Pan's office, I saw Ke Accountant sneakily eavesdropping at the door. When leaving, he even bumped into me.
Having been in the hospital for so long, I could roughly guess that Dr. Zhen is treacherous and has done countless bad things. He must have poisoned my sister behind the scenes to compete for the director position.
On January 30th, the opportunity came. Dr. Zhen was indeed promoted to director. Everyone had dinner together that evening, but I stayed behind for night duty instead of going. That night I snuck into Director Zhen's office and found chronic poison in his drawer. I took the poison away - it might be useful.
But that night while I was sleeping in the rest room, Director Zhen suddenly sent me a message with photos of me and Deputy Director Pan on dates, plus some records of missing anesthetic, sedative, and stimulant drugs from the hospital. He threatened me to immediately meet him at a hotel. I had no choice but to go. But I didn't expect that he not only wanted me to spend the night with him but also demanded 200,000 yuan as hush money. If it were just that, I could have endured it, but I was afraid he would keep threatening me, which would ruin my life. I could only eliminate him. I thought of the poison I took from him.
From that day on, I secretly put poison in the mineral water barrels delivered to his office every day. I put the medicine in syringes and injected it into the water barrels. This way, no one would know.
[February 3rd - Night of the Incident]
18:00 - Deputy Director Pan and I finished the last surgery together. After the surgery, I left the operating room and went to the front desk for duty.
18:30 - I saw Ke Accountant walk by. I asked him why he left work half an hour late. He said there were too many accounts and he worked overtime.
19:00 - I finished dinner and returned to the front desk for duty.
20:40 - I saw Wei Daughter go upstairs carrying a lunch box, probably delivering food to Director Zhen. She's Director Zhen's daughter.
21:40 - After sitting for so long, I prepared to walk around.
21:45 - I went to the second floor and passed Director Zhen's office. Since I had poisoned him, I was quite concerned about his movements. I saw him lying on the desk as if asleep. Probably being poisoned, his spirits weren't very good.
21:50 - I returned to the first-floor rest room, planning to sleep for a while.
23:00 - After sleeping for about an hour, the alarm went off. I put on my white coat and went out. I saw the second floor had lost power, so I took a flashlight upstairs to check. After searching around, I reached the morgue and found Director Zhen dead there, his heart removed. It was terrifying. I fled immediately.
23:10 - I went to the rest room to calm down for a while, changed out of the white coat that accidentally got blood on it in the morgue, and then called the police.
acts_goal: Find the real culprit of this case, try to hide your sisterly relationship with Dr. Jia.
